text: No e nduu Suudu, Maandeeji ɓannginɗi ɓural e teddungal mayru; wano dewe hajju ɗen, e hayre ɓaleere nde Annabi Ibraahiima darinoo e mun fewndo e faandinoo ɓamtugol mahdi Kaaba ndin, no e majje kadi, wonnde kala naatuɗo e mayru, kulol ɓooroto e makko; o heɓataa lorra woo. No waɗɗanii Alla e dow yimɓe ɓen, faandorgol nduu suudu fii dewe hajju ɗen, wonannde on kattanɗo hewtugol e mayru. Kala yedduɗo farilla hajju on, pellet, Alla ko Yonndiniiɗo e geddo Yonndinii e denndaanga winndere nde.
